name: @peri-code/workflow
description: Workflow runner for the Perihelion agent — JSON-RPC 2.0 stdio bridge. Host-language-agnostic: any language that can spawn a Node child process and speak JSON-RPC over stdin/stdout can integrate. Built-in CLI subcommands (read/list) for inspecting run results.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test:coverage
